excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin. Wears signature thin-rimmed BLACK RECTANGULAR lens glasses, a light blue tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, blue jean slacks and black dress shoes.
excavation_context.stage: Pneumatic Air-Scribing an Enormous Theropod Jaw

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1, wearing his signature thin-rimmed black rectangular lens glasses, guides a vibrating pneumatic air-scribe tool across a heavy block of consolidated tan sandstone matrix on his lab bench. The coarse matrix fragments away under bright hood lights to uncover the massive, formidable lower jaw of a Tarbosaurus. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
